# Direction Prompts

Use these prompts to quickly generate distinct visual directions before implementing.

## Direction A - Editorial Modern

- Tone: confident, spacious, typographic.
- Typography: high-contrast heading + neutral body font.
- Color: restrained base with one assertive accent.
- Layout: asymmetric hero, generous whitespace, clear vertical rhythm.

## Direction B - Productive Dashboard

- Tone: precise, operational, trustworthy.
- Typography: compact UI font with strong hierarchy.
- Color: muted neutrals with status-driven accents.
- Layout: modular zones with clear task grouping and action density.

## Direction C - Playful Utility

- Tone: energetic, approachable, modern.
- Typography: expressive display + readable supporting text.
- Color: warm/cool contrast pair with soft neutrals.
- Layout: bolder section boundaries, shaped backgrounds, lively highlights.
